name: First Mate Fitzsimmons
summary: Outside Menethil Harbor's Deepwater Tavern, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks through the days. Once first mate of the Wave Mistress in Kul Tiras's Third Fleet, he is its sole known living survivor after the fleet's destruction in the Second War. Now he seeks travelers willing to face the restless spirits of his drowned comrades.

sections.title: A Broken Sailor
sections.body: Outside the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, First Mate Fitzsimmons drinks alone. His unwashed stench keeps many patrons away, and most see only a broken old sailor drowning his memories. Those who sit and listen hear how a proud fleet fell to fire and claw.

sections.title: The Fall of the Third Fleet
sections.body: During the Second War, Fitzsimmons served aboard the Wave Mistress as first mate. The ship sailed with Kul Tiras's Third Fleet to fight the Horde. Off the Wetlands coast, Dragonmaw orcs ambushed the fleet with enslaved red dragons and burned its ships. The vessels broke apart and sank. Fitzsimmons alone managed to reach shore alive.

sections.title: The Lingering Curse
sections.body: First Mate Fitzsimmons survived the dragonfire, but his former crewmates did not find rest. Their ships, remembered as the Lost Fleet, now hold cursed undead sailors trapped in watery graves. Haunted by guilt and terror, Fitzsimmons asks travelers to put the sailors down and recover ancient relics that might lift the evil binding their souls.

faq.answer: First Mate Fitzsimmons is an old Kul Tiran sailor who once served as first mate of the Wave Mistress. He survived the destruction of Kul Tiras's Third Fleet in the Second War and now drinks outside Menethil Harbor's Deepwater Tavern.
During the Second War, enslaved red dragons flown by Dragonmaw orcs ambushed the Wave Mistress and the rest of the Third Fleet. The vessels burned and broke apart on the reef off the Wetlands coast.

faq.q: Where is the Lost Fleet located?
faq.answer: The Lost Fleet's shattered hulls lie submerged along the rocky Wetlands coast north of Menethil Harbor. Murlocs and the restless spirits of drowned sailors guard them.

faq.q: Why does he want adventurers to fight his old crew?
faq.answer: The drowned sailors of the Third Fleet rose as cursed, tormented undead. Fitzsimmons seeks travelers to put them to rest and recover the artifacts that keep their souls shackled.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
faq.answer: The Eye of Paleth is an ancient, potent artifact carried aboard the Third Fleet. Its dark power is tied to the curse afflicting the sunken sailors, and recovering it is crucial to granting the drowned fleet peace.

faq.q: Why does Fitzsimmons smell so bad?
faq.answer: Fitzsimmons lost everything when his fleet went down and now lives in drunken neglect outside the Deepwater Tavern. He wears sea-soaked rags and rarely washes.

angles.text: Fitzsimmons recalls a tragic chapter in Alliance naval history and the losses suffered against the Horde's enslaved dragon armada.
As a human, you share a kinship with Fitzsimmons, a veteran of Kul Tiras. His people made great sacrifices to defend Lordaeron during the Second War.
